AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#325 @ b0c02156dd86f00e0bfef80a7b517c46ddfb8f2d — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent paired T4 first audit, **A/B/C: 0/1/2**, with backend #634 `dbc10b7b68436dad567e87057d240fbc5f51a4a8`; no prior AUDIT comment was present at initial read. This is the branch's 45-file merge-base diff, not a claim that newer main's account-deletion/Health Connect changes are reverted: merge-tree with mobile main e3986e89 is clean. [Mobile candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325), [backend prerequisite](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634).

**B-325-1 — A valid backend phone-call link is silently unusable on the client.** Backend #634 `src/scheduling/scheduling.types.ts:109-115` accepts bounded `tel:` links and marks them ready; its lifecycle test explicitly saves `tel:+1 425 555 0100`. Mobile `src/api/schedulingApi.ts:79-83` returns null for every tel link, so `CalendarSessionScreen.tsx:30-32,107,158-177` never offers Join/Call; with server `meeting_link_status:'ready'`, clientLinkLine also gives no missing-link explanation. Phone-calendar export discards the number, and coach inbox input permits only https. Independent extraction of the exact candidate resolver returns null for `tel:+14255550100`, with the https control retained. Minimal fix: support the backend's safe, bounded phone-call contract end to end (normalize/validate tel, an explicit Call action using Linking, truthful phone-calendar note/URL and coach entry), retaining rejection of arbitrary schemes and credential-bearing URLs. Add native-screen tests proving the ready telephone session has a working action and rejected dialer actions give an actionable error. Do not resolve this by cutting the accepted backend phone-call functionality. [Mobile link handling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325), [accepted backend contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634).

**C-325-1 — Centralize and verify the release support destination.** New `CalendarHomeScreen.tsx:244-245` and `schedulingErrors.ts:82` hardcode Bradley@Bradleytgpcoaching.com independently of other app support surfaces. This is not evidence that the address is broken; choose the owner-approved release address in one shared constant and use it in visible copy/mailto/referenced-error recovery tests so later contact changes do not strand only Calendar. [Added support surfaces](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325).

**C-325-2 — Repeat the manual phone-calendar update instruction after a move.** `CalendarBookScreen.tsx:54-63` says only that the session moved and the coach has the new time; cancellation, export and tutorial already explain that copies do not auto-sync. Add the same concise instruction to the move-success state, with a screen assertion, so a user who exported before rescheduling does not forget the independent old copy. [Move and export copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325).

The paired backend review independently reproduces four must-fix lifecycle/delivery/history defects, including B-634-4 requiring a compound cursor change here (`useCalendar.ts:127-133` currently returns only the last timestamp). Those remain dependencies, not duplicated mobile finding IDs; do not merge/release the pair on route readiness or green unit tests alone. [Backend integration boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634).

Read native booking/detail/home, coach type/time-off/weekly-hours/inbox/settings, typed API and query-cache paths, timezone/DST helpers, phone-calendar permissions/editor/result boundary, notification normalization/tap routing, flag-gated navigation and tutorial changes, and acceptance tests. The stable-code map covers all 19 backend scheduling codes, slot conflict refresh and CALENDAR_BUSY definite-not-booked semantics; unknown errors use a sanitized reference/support path and Sentry, not raw axios secrets. The OS editor result deliberately does not claim Android saved the event; there is no full-calendar read, account linking or automatic sync. [Reviewed scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325).

All three required checks SUCCESS at exact head; actual installed-lock-graph CI ran typecheck/lint and **408 suites / 5,537 tests PASS**, including native calendar, API, time, phone-calendar, scheduling-error, coach settings, notification and tutorial suites. No local dependency installation, mobile Jest or tsc rerun: candidate adds expo-calendar (~56.0.8, locked 56.0.10), which is absent from the shared depot; operator must update that depot before local native validation. Independent tiny resolver probe is saved as `ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-111/325-phone-link-probe.log`; it does not claim device validation. [Executed installed-graph CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36974940788/job/110736615302).

No push, merge, workflow dispatch or production action. Retain coordinated backend rollout, explicit launch reminder switch, and iOS/Android device acceptance for native editor, dialing, push/center tap and inaccessible-link recovery; the legacy uncalled ClientBookingRequest route remains outside this new flow. [Remaining prerequisites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#325 @ b0c02156dd86f00e0bfef80a7b517c46ddfb8f2d — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent paired T4 first audit with backend #634 @ `dbc10b7b68436dad567e87057d240fbc5f51a4a8`, which is REQUEST CHANGES ([my verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634#issuecomment-5956298627)). **My count: A0 / B2 / C5.** Sol's verdict (comment 5955781501) arrived while I was auditing. I cite Sol's IDs where we overlap and continue the numbering for my new findings. The pair dependencies B-634-1 (an approve can confirm a different time than the one read; the inbox should send `expected_start_at`) and B-634-4 (the past cursor must send the id, `src/hooks/useCalendar.ts:127-133`) need matching changes here.

### B (must fix)

**B-325-1 (concur with Sol): a `tel:` call link is ready on the server but cannot be used in the app.**
- Backend `MEETING_LINK_PATTERN` (`scheduling.types.ts:98`) accepts `tel:` and reports `meeting_link_status: 'ready'`.
- Mobile `resolveVideoUrl` (`src/api/schedulingApi.ts:79-84`) returns null for any non-http(s) link. So the client gets no Join or Call button and no explanation.
- Minimal fix: resolve a bounded `tel:` link to a Call action through `Linking`. Keep rejecting every other scheme.

**B-325-2 (new): coaches get client-worded error copy that gives the wrong next step.**
- `calendarErrorMessage` maps codes through the single client-facing `SCHEDULING_CODE_MESSAGES` table (`src/calendar/schedulingErrors.ts:26-47,53-54`).
- It is also used on every coach surface:
  - `CoachBookingInboxScreen.tsx:56,68,108`
  - `CoachAppointmentTypesScreen.tsx:125,145`
  - time off and availability screens.
- Probe (`src/calendar/__tests__/auditProbe325.test.ts`) using the real server bodies:
  - **Coach confirms a request whose time has passed.** The server sends 409 `SESSION_STARTED` with "Decline it so the client can pick a new time". The app shows "This session has already started, so it can no longer be changed here. Message your coach if you need help."
  - **Coach saves a type that is no longer there.** The server sends 404 `SESSION_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE`. The app shows "This appointment type is no longer offered. Go back to Calendar and choose another type." The coach navigator has no Calendar tab.
  - **Coach restores a type and hits B-634-5.** The server sends 409 `SESSION_STATE_CHANGED`. The app shows "This session changed a moment ago. Refresh Calendar".
- This breaks the copy rule that every failure says what happened and what to do next.
- Minimal fix: add an audience parameter (`calendarErrorMessage(err, op, 'coach')`) with a coach table for at least `SESSION_STARTED`, `SESSION_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE`, `SESSION_STATE_CHANGED`, `NOT_SESSION_PARTICIPANT` and `COACH_NOT_BOOKABLE`. Alternatively, show the server's coded `message` on coach screens. Add one test per coach screen.

### C (follow-up)
- **C-325-1 and C-325-2 (concur with Sol):** the support address is hardcoded in two places, and the move-success state should repeat that phone-calendar copies need a manual update.
- **C-325-3 (pair with C-634-3):** the inbox and agenda come from `useMyUpcomingSessions(100)` and are filtered on the device (`CoachBookingInboxScreen.tsx:97,113-123`). Cancelled and declined rows count toward the 100, so a busy coach can miss a pending request. Use a server status filter or pagination.
- **C-325-4:** moving a confirmed approval-type session gives no warning that the confirmed time is released now and that a decline leaves no session.
  - The book screen shows only "{coach} confirms each request." and "Move to this time" (`CalendarBookScreen.tsx:283,330`).
  - Add one line before submit (see C-634-4).
- **C-325-5:** on Android, the `expo-calendar` plugin (`app.json:128-136`) adds `READ_CALENDAR` and `WRITE_CALENDAR`. The feature only opens the OS editor intent, which needs neither permission. Add both to `android.blockedPermissions` to keep store disclosures minimal.
- **C-325-6:** phone-calendar notes hardcode "Personal-training session with {coach}" (`src/calendar/phoneCalendar.ts:43`). Use the type name or a neutral "Coaching session".

### Evidence
- Head re-read: `b0c02156` throughout. The PR is still a Draft, and the body lists unresolved prerequisites, including device acceptance.
- All three required checks (Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze js-ts, Analyze actions) are SUCCESS at this head.
- Merge-tree with main `e3986e89` is clean (tree `f25c9112`). The PR is BEHIND, so strict protection needs update-branch before merge.
- Locally, in a worktree at this head via heavy.sh: `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand` passed 10 suites / 145 tests (calendar screens, coach scheduling settings, scheduling API, phone calendar, scheduling errors, calendar time, push tap router, notification normalizer, tutorial calendar flag, plus my probe). `expo-calendar` is mocked virtually in `jest.setup.js`, and the lock resolves 56.0.10.
- Checked and not a finding:
  - The flag is off by default and gated in the navigator, tutorial and push table.
  - Push taps route `CalendarSession` and `CoachBookingInbox` through the allow-list, and the backend emitter sends `actionScreen`/`actionParams`.
  - The iOS write-only calendar string is set, and `remindersPermission: false`.
  - Android save results are never overclaimed.
  - The deprecated `client_timezone` and `notes` are stripped before strict DTOs.
  - The legacy `ClientBookingRequest` route has no navigate callers.
- No push, merge, dispatch or production action.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#325 @ 13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Fix round S-SCHED-3, paired with backend #634 @ `2a07ab25` (APPROVE). It follows my RC at `b0c02156` ([5956311187](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5956311187)) and Sol's RC ([5955781501](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5955781501)). **A0 / B1 / C0.**
- Every prior B and C from both lenses is closed.
- The one open item is a one-line value change required by today's support-address ruling, which arrived after this push.

### B (must fix)
**B-325-3: the new central support constant uses a non-canonical address.**
- **Where:** `src/config/support.ts:5` sets `SUPPORT_EMAIL = 'Bradley@Bradleytgpcoaching.com'`.
- **Ruling:** the operator ruled the canonical support address is `Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com`.
- **Impact:** this PR routes every user-facing support next step through that constant:
  - Calendar errors (`src/calendar/schedulingErrors.ts:2,141-142`).
  - Calendar home: the "contact …" note and the Contact support mailto (`CalendarHomeScreen.tsx:21,245-246`).
  - Account-deletion errors and `HELP_UNAVAILABLE_COPY` (`src/screens/settings/deletionErrors.ts:9-12,125,128`).
- **Collision with #327:** data-export #327 @ `7e643f9b` adds `src/constants/support.ts` with `SUPPORT_EMAIL = "Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com"`. Together, the two PRs would ship two support modules with different addresses.
- **Minimal fix:** set `src/config/support.ts:5` to `'Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com'`. Whichever of #325 and #327 lands second should re-export the other module so there is one constant. No test edits are needed: `schedulingErrors.test.ts:105` asserts against the constant, and no test hardcodes the old literal.

### Prior findings
| Finding | Status at this head | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| B-325-1 ready `tel:` links unusable | Closed | `resolveCallLink` (`src/api/schedulingApi.ts`) mirrors backend `MEETING_LINK_PATTERN` (`scheduling.types.ts:104`): https within 490 characters, or `tel:` with 3-30 characters. Call goes through `Linking`, and a refused dialer gets a message that gives the number (`CalendarSessionScreen.tsx:57-65`). Coach entry is normalised by `normalizeCallLinkInput`. |
| B-325-2 client copy on coach screens | Closed | `COACH_CODE_MESSAGES` (`schedulingErrors.ts:61-71`) and coach fallbacks (`:95-127`). Every coach screen passes `'coach'`: Inbox `:71,83,130,162,286`, Appointment types `:125,145,175`, Time off `:91,106,128,170`, Availability `:144,186,333`. Copy has no exclamation marks, and each message gives a next step. |
| C-325-1 support address hardcoded | Closed as a single constant | The value is wrong; see B-325-3. |
| C-325-2 move success | Closed | The note repeats the manual phone-calendar update after a move. |
| C-325-3 inbox filtered on device | Closed | `useUpcomingSessionsByStatus` sends server `status`, with pages of 50 on `(start_at, id)`. Mutations invalidate the `['scheduling','sessions','me']` prefix, which covers the new keys. |
| C-325-4 approval-type move | Closed (ruling) | The pre-move warning ships now. |
| C-325-5 calendar permissions | Closed | `app.json` `android.blockedPermissions`, merged in `app.config.js:34-36`. |
| C-325-6 "Personal-training session" | Closed | The type name, else "Coaching session". |

### Contract with #634
- Approve sends `expected_start_at` (`useScheduling.ts:156-161`), and so do decline and cancel (`CoachBookingInboxScreen.tsx:81,136-137`).
- The backend DTOs accept it as optional ISO-8601 (`scheduling.dto.ts:176-189`).
- `SESSION_MOVED` is mapped for both audiences.

### Merge, tests and checks
- **Merge:** `d0873d3` = merge of `b0c0215` + main `e3986e8`. Tree `f25c9112` equals `git merge-tree`, so there is no hand edit. The head contains main `e3986e89` (strict protection is satisfied).
- **Local (`--runInBand`):** 8 suites, 133 passed, 0 failed. They are `schedulingCallLinkAndCursor`, `phoneCalendar`, `schedulingErrors`, `calendarTime`, `calendarPermissionsBlocked`, `calendarScreens`, `coachSchedulingFixRound` and `conciergePhase1`.
- **CI at this exact head:** Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze (js-ts) and Analyze (actions) are SUCCESS.

No push, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#325 @ 13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

T4 scheduling pair re-audit. **A/B/C = 0/2/0.** B-325-1 and C-325-2/3/5/6 close; C-325-4 is accepted under the pre-move-warning ruling, not a finding. B-325-2 is partial; the centralized support value is the parallel lens's new B-325-3, not a duplicate ID. [Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5955781501), [new parallel verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5957864001).

### B-325-2 — expired approval still gives the coach an impossible next action

`src/calendar/schedulingErrors.ts:61` maps coach `SESSION_STARTED` to “Mark it complete or no-show after it ends,” including when Inbox Confirm returns that code for an expired **requested** session. Backend `approvalTooLate` instead correctly instructs Decline; requested sessions do not permit either completed or no_show transitions, and the request card exposes Confirm/Decline, not those proposed controls. [Actual mobile mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fcalendar%2FschedulingErrors.ts), [Inbox](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fscreens%2Fcoach%2FCoachBookingInboxScreen.tsx), [backend transition table and approval refusal](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/2a07ab25ef0b4b1c563d7c8542fb3abc6018cf0c/src%2Fscheduling%2Fscheduling-session-lifecycle.service.ts).

Minimal fix: context-aware approval copy that says the requested time passed and directs the coach to **Decline** so the client can choose another time; retain separately valid next steps for already-confirmed sessions. Add a semantic regression against the actual expired-request response/available actions, rather than just asserting the same exported constant or absence of client wording. [Current mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fcalendar%2FschedulingErrors.ts), [parallel claim to reconcile](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5957864001).

### B-325-3 — canonical support destination remains wrong

Carry the parallel finding: `src/config/support.ts:5` sets `Bradley@Bradleytgpcoaching.com`, not the operator's canonical `Bradleyapple1031@gmail.com`; the actual `supportMailto()` therefore targets the wrong address across Calendar/deletion recovery. This is a violation of the resolved address ruling, not a request to revisit it. [Support constant](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fconfig%2Fsupport.ts), [parallel finding and integration collision](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5957864001).

Minimal fix: use the canonical value and converge the competing #327 support module by re-exporting a single constant; test the independently specified destination rather than compare output to the same possibly wrong constant. [Parallel B-325-3](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5957864001).

### Evidence and boundaries

Auditor exact-source TypeScript-transpilation probe, through `heavy.sh node ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-111/325-q2-r3-exact-source-probe.cjs`, executed the actual error mapper/API code parser and support helper with only API/Sentry doubles: **2/2 failed expectations, exit 1**, reproducing both findings. This is **not mounted React or native/device evidence**; no install/local Jest on the changed expo-calendar graph. [Actual mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fcalendar%2FschedulingErrors.ts), [actual helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e/src%2Fconfig%2Fsupport.ts).

Pure main merge `d0873d3` reconstructs exact tree `f25c91120b0d8451f1151af844c07322c4153b58`; before/after stable own patch IDs match `2e9df557…`. All three required exact-head checks SUCCESS; installed CI executed **411 suites / 5,584 tests PASS**, including the new scheduling/permission/link regressions, but they do not semantically establish a legal expired-request next action. [Exact candidate and parallel merge proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325#issuecomment-5957864001), [executed CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37040063439/job/110947695372).

No push, merge, workflow dispatch or production/device action. New native Calendar binary and device acceptance remain release prerequisites, not claimed by Jest/CI approval.
